Method of Attack: Trojanized installer distributing multiple malware infections including Monero miner and SupremeBot mining client
Monero miner collects hardware info and mines cryptocurrency via connection to gulf.moneroocean.stream
SupremeBot creates scheduled tasks, hides processes, establishes C2 connection for mining config and payload delivery
Final payload Umbral Stealer steals browser data, credentials, cryptocurrency wallets, takes screenshots, uses webcams, disables Windows Defender, modifies hosts file to block antivirus communication
Attack Vector: Trojanized game installer distributed as self-extracting archive executable via unknown channels including gaming forums, social media groups, malvertising, Black SEO
Indicators of Compromise: Modification of Windows hosts file to block antivirus sites
